verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents an official CLI on its own integrations page. It creates inboxes, sends messages and manages threads without code, and ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies. A probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documented detail on AI-native specifics such as machine-readable output, authentication flow and a full command reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Create inboxes, send messages, manage threads, and more — all without writing code. It ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies.
